text:
sara: Hey team, quick oneI don't see the 'Templates' button when I'm in Product Notion pages. I want to save an onboarding page as a reusable template for PMs. Do I need a special permission?

devex-bot: Heads up: workspace-level template picker for team pages is controlled by folder/db permissions. Non-admin folks can't add to the team-wide template picker unless the page lives in a template-enabled database or someone with edit rights saves it for the team. Guide: https://redwood.docs/notion-templates

nate: We usually create a folder Product > Team Templates and put canonical template pages there. Then a Product admin or template owner copies the page into the DB and uses the DB's "New" template feature. If you want, paste your page link here and I can help convert it.

sara: Thanks. If I drop the page in Team Templates will that make it show up for everyone automatically?

nate: Not automatically in the DB picker. Two options: 1) Put it in Team Templates and ask an admin to register it with the DB (small manual step), or 2) create the page inside the DB as a template entry (if you can edit the DB).

karen: Quick how-to we use: 
- Create page under Product > Team Templates with title prefix "Template: "
- Add frontmatter block at top: Owner, Role (e.g., PM, Eng), Visibility (internal/public), LastReviewed
- Open the target database (Onboarding DB) > New > Templates > "+" > Choose "Create template from page" and paste content
If you can't access the DB's template editor, file a template-perm request and tag @karen so I can approve.

sara: What name convention do we prefer? I have a couple of pages for "PM ramp" and "PM tools notes"

karen: Use: Template: <Role> - <ShortPurpose> - YYYYMM (e.g., "Template: PM - Ramp - 202603"). That makes monthly consolidation easy. Also add these tags: onboarding, template, product.

ops-bot: Reminder: If your page contains customer data or credentials, mark it as "sensitive" and do NOT add to public team templates. Use the guest/secure templates flow: https://redwood.workflows/secure-template-request

sara: Got it. I'll move the page into Product > Team Templates and follow the naming & frontmatter. @nate can you help with the DB step later?

nate: Yep, ping me after you move it and I'll hook it into the onboarding DB template. :thumbsup:

karen: Also FYI we run a monthly sweep to de-duplicate templates. If the template is a one-off we might keep it local, otherwise we'll canonicalize it into Product > Official Templates.

sara: Perfect, thanks everyone!
